topic: MVP scoping: what to leave out of version one
caption:
The fastest way to launch your MVP? Decide what NOT to build. ✂️

5 things most first versions can safely leave out:

1️⃣ Every user role on day one
2️⃣ A custom admin dashboard
3️⃣ "Nice-to-have" integrations
4️⃣ Pixel-perfect animations
5️⃣ Building for a million users

Cut these and you ship sooner, learn faster and spend your budget on what your users actually need. Swipe for the why. →

Not sure what belongs in your v1? DM us MVP with your idea in one line and we'll help you trim it.

Save this for your next planning session. 🔖

#MVP #StartupTips #Founders #ProductManagement #AppDevelopment #SoftwareDevelopment #TechStartup #LeanStartup

slides.title: 5 things to leave out of version one.
slides.sub: Ship sooner by deciding what not to build.

slides.title: Every user role
slides.body: Launch for the one user who feels the problem most. Add other roles once the core flow works.

slides.title: A custom admin dashboard
slides.body: Early on, a simple internal tool or a managed admin panel is usually enough. Build custom later.

slides.title: Nice-to-have integrations
slides.body: Keep the integrations your core flow can't work without. Park the rest on the roadmap.

slides.title: Pixel-perfect animations
slides.body: A clean, consistent UI beats custom motion in v1. Polish the screens people use most.

slides.title: Building for a million users
slides.body: Use a solid, scalable foundation, but don't over-engineer for traffic you don't have yet.

slides.title: Let's trim it together.
slides.sub: Send us your idea and we'll help you find the smallest version worth launching.
